analyst_view.overall: Lille are 35th with 1 point from 4 games and lost 1-0 at home to Lyon on Friday, so this is close to their last chance of the play-offs; Tiago Santos and Igamane are out (counted), Nianzou is a doubt and Ethan Mbappé returns from a ban. Bayern (13th, 8 points) drew 1-1 with Köln and are badly hit: Harry Kane had ankle surgery and is out for about three months, and Gnabry, Saibari, Davies and Neuer are out too. The numbers' missing list no longer includes Kane, so his absence is not in them now; Michael Olise (bruised foot, on crutches at the weekend) also missed Monday's training and Bild calls his return increasingly unlikely, which the numbers don't know either. German press expect 18-year-old Lennart Karl through the middle, with Luis Díaz and Musiala possible. Italian referee Marco Guida (3.6 cards a game) is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, 1.7 of them Bayern's, and take Gnabry, Saibari and Davies off but no longer list Kane. Without Kane, their main scorer, and very likely Olise, Bayern's attack loses its two biggest sources of goals, so I take 12% off the match, to about 2.5. Lille have been short of goals too (none against Lyon), and Díaz possibly returning is what keeps me from going further.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.7 corners, split almost evenly. A makeshift Bayern front line may be less dangerous but should still have the ball, while Lille must push for a win at home; these pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3 cards, already cut about 12% for referee Marco Guida's low card count and 12% for Bayern's quiet recent record. Lille's must-win mood could add a booking late on, but that is a hunch, so I stay at 3.

shots.text: The numbers say 25 shots, nearly 15 from Bayern, and the missing-player adjustment does not touch shots anyway. Kane and Olise are Bayern's two most frequent shooters, and a young line led by Lennart Karl should create less; Lille needing a win stops me going further, so about 23.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. Without Kane and probably Olise, Bayern lose their best finishers, and the numbers count neither, so I go down to about 8.4.
